color-by-number.name: Kala ena namba dekenai
color-by-number.seoTitle: Color by Number: a Calm Large-Print Fill Game
color-by-number.h1: Kala ena namba dekenai: sikwea ena hanai, kala ta ai dekenai
color-by-number.description: Gridi ena sikwea namba bada 1 ai, bona kala 4 ena nama ena hanai key. Kala ta dekenai, bona sikwea ena hanai tapi. Taima o skoa lao, bona button ta namba ena hanai ena sikwea ena hanai. Gemu o prinit ena hanai moni lao.
color-by-number.short: Kala ta dekenai, bona sikwea namba ena hanai tapi ena kala ena hanai.
color-by-number.intro: A square grid of large squares, each with a number, and a key above it with four colors, each with its number and its written name. Choose a color from the key, then tap squares to fill them. The grid is 4 by 4 to start, with 6 by 6 and 8 by 8 when you want more squares. When every square has the color of its number, the grid is the picture on the sheet. Squares filled with any other color are simply your own picture, and the game says nothing about it. "Fill with the numbers" fills every empty square for you.
howTo: Gridi ena bada dekenai. 4 by 4 ena sikwea bada ena hanai, bona ena hanai gaukara.
Gridi ena lalo key ta dekenai. Kala tasi ena namba bona ena nama ena hanai, hanai "1 Yelo".
Tap a color in the key, then tap the squares you would like to fill with it.
Use the color on the number, or any color you like. Both are fine.
Tap "Fill with the numbers" for the empty squares, "Clear" to start the grid again, or "Another picture" for a different one.
tips: Karakara ena hanai, bona dala ena hanai: tanona tasi ena kala dekenai, tanona hadia ena sikwea tapi.
Kala ena hanai hereva: "Ai green ena hanai dae." Pikitia ena nama ena hanai ta dekenai, ena hanai lao.
On a narrow screen the 8 by 8 grid scrolls sideways inside its own box. The squares stay a comfortable size.
The paper version works as well with pencils at a bedside table.

faq.q: Taima o skoa ena hanai dae?
faq.a: Ia. Taima, skoa, move counter o hadia ena hanai lao. Ai ena hanai ena gemu ena hanai, bona hanai ena gemu ena hanai io.

faq.q: Namba ena kala hadia ena hanai ai?
faq.a: Nothing happens, and that is the point. Any color can go in any square, and the game says nothing about it. When every square has the color of its number the game says so gently, and a picture in your own colors is just as good.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a number, a written name and its own small shape, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four fills were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness, and they also differ in lightness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Sikwea ena hanai lima ena hanai o telefon kiki ena hanai bada ai?
faq.a: Every square is at least 48 pixels across, and 56 on the 4 by 4 grid. If a grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Peipa ena versio ena hanai ai?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has a numbered grid and the key of four colors with their names. Color each square with a pencil of the color on its number, or any color you like.

faq.q: Ena moni ai, bona oi akaunt ta rejistra ena hanai?

pattern-maker.seoTitle: Pattern maker: tail ta dizaina, bona pattern prinit
pattern-maker.h1: Pattern maker: tail ta dizaina, pattern ena hanai dekenai
pattern-maker.description: Tail tasi ena sikwea ena hanai dekenai, bona ena hanai pattern ena lalonai ena hanai. Kala 4 ena nama bona shape ena hanai. Taima o skoa lao. Gemu o prinit ena hanai moni lao.
pattern-maker.short: Tail ena sikwea ena hanai dekenai, bona pattern ena hanai dekenai.
pattern-maker.intro: A small tile of 3 by 3 squares, or 4 by 4 if you like, and beside it "your pattern": the same tile repeated in a block. Tap a square and it changes to the next of four colors, each with its own written name and shape. The pattern beside it changes at once. There is no right pattern and nothing is saved or sent. "Print my pattern" puts the repeated pattern on one page to keep, color in or give away.
howTo: Tail o oi pattern ena lalonai dekenai. Tail ta ena hanai block ena hanai.
Tap a square. It changes to the next color in the row of four colors above.
Keep tapping squares until the pattern looks the way you would like. Any pattern is a good one.
Tap "Surprise me" for a new tile, or "Start again" for a clear one. "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.
Tap "Print my pattern" if you would like it on paper, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Ita tanobada ela, bada taudia rua ia taudia tasi ia square ena, tasi ia hereva ena gau ia dibaia.
Hereva gau ia dibaia: "Ia ela gau ta." Ena dekenai ia ela sia hereva ena gau.
Tile ta ia colour rua gabu, bada taudia rua ia hereva, bada colour dekenai ia gabu.

sort-together.name: Hapararaia hebou
sort-together.seoTitle: Sorting Game: Sort Together for Adults
sort-together.description: Gini dekenai ia-ia hanai, eda basket ta ena belong ena: kitchen bona garden, fruit bona animals. Calm, free sorting game taudia bona famili ena.
sort-together.short: Laulau ta ta ena bosea lalonai atoa: ruma ruma lalonai eiava uma gabu, bona ma haida.
sort-together.intro: Gau hapararaia be dina ibounai gaukara namona bona hegeregere, aniani atoa eiava sokisi hegeregere gogoa bamona. Laulau ta tohoa, bena ena bosea korikori tohoa. Lalo-hagaia lasi bona kerere lasi.
howTo: Uru ta abia hidi: ruma ruma lalonai bona uma gabu, huahua bona boroma/manu, eiava ruma bona laolao.
Laulau ta tohoa. Golo isena ia abia.
Ena bosea korikori tohoa. Laulau be unai bosea lalonai ia lao.
Bema ia be bosea ta totona, gadara ese manoka ia herevaia bona ia naria.
Laulau ibounai oi hapararaia vaitani neganai, bosea lalonai gadoi hebou.

Gau korikoridia hapararaia, sipunu bona pata eiava auki kaladia hegeregere, be skrin murimurinai gaukara namona danu.

picture-puzzle.short: Kahana rua tohoa gabu senisia totona ela bona laulau ia hegeregere.
picture-puzzle.intro: Gini ena dekenai ta ia-ia 4 bona 9 large piece ena cut, bona mix ena. Gini lalonai ena dae, guide ena. Piece 1 ia-ia tap, bona piece 2 ia-ia tap, ia-ia swap ena. Dragging ena dekenai. Ta ena photo ia hanai ta ena dekenai ia-ia. Device ta ena dae, upload ena dekenai.

Laulau idoinai ataiai itaia.

finish-the-saying.name: Hereva hadokoa
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Finish the Saying: Familiar Sayings Game
finish-the-saying.description: Hereva hegeregeredia mai hereva dokona ia boio, "Moni maragina oi naria be moni maragina ___" bamona. Abia hidi ta tohoa eiava dokona hahedinaraia, bena herevalaia.
finish-the-saying.short: Hereva hegeregeredia hadokoa hebou, bena herevalaia.
finish-the-saying.intro: Hereva gunadia be mauri lalonai ita diba momo. Kasi ta ta ese hereva ia hahedinaraia mai dokona ia noho lasi, abia hidi toi, bona "Dokona hahedinaraia" batona. Dokona murinai, henanadai manokana ese herevahereva ia veria mai.
howTo: Hereva duahia henia hebou.
Hereva ia hadokoa tohoa, eiava "Dokona hahedinaraia" tohoa.
Hereva idoinai duahia lou bona henanadai amo herevahereva.
Oi hegaegae neganai "Hereva ma ta" tohoa.
tips: Duahia metau bona doho maragimaragi hereva dokona do oi gwauraia lasi neganai. Nega momo taunimanima idia gwauraia guna.
Bema tauna ta ese dokona idau ia henia, moalelaia. Hereva haida be ruma bese eiava gabu idauidau hegeregere idau.
Orea lalonai, tauna ta ia duahia bona ibounai ese dokona idia gwauraia hebou.

word-search.description: Free large-print word search taudia bona famili ena. Word momo, letter big, word across bona down ena dekenai. Online ena play bona print.
word-search.short: Leta badadia, hereva sisina mo, hekure bona hekei mo. Pepa latanai torea diba danu.
word-search.intro: Maua maragina mai leta badadia bona hereva sisina mo, iboudiai be hekure eiava hekei idia heau. Hereva ena leta ginigunana tupua, bena ena leta dokona tupua. Pepa oi ura? Nega tamona tupua bona pepa matamata torea.
howTo: Hereva ena dala bona maua ena bada abia hidi.
Hereva lista itaia. Hereva be hekure (lauri dekena amo idiba kahana) eiava hekei (ataia amo henunai) idia heau.
Hereva ena leta ginigunana tupua, bena ena leta dokona tupua.

Pepa latanai, maka badana dogoatao be mai manokana, pensil hegeregerena lasi.

coloring.seoTitle: Free Adult Coloring Pages, Large and Simple
coloring.description: Kala henia rauadia hegeregere badadia taumatoi totona: kala ta tupua, bena laulau tupua.
coloring.short: Kala ta tupua, bena laulau kahana ta tupua. Pepa latanai torea diba danu.
coloring.intro: Raua mai toana badadia bona manokadia: heuro uro lalonai, ruma, ti kapuna, bebebe bona bouti. Kala ta tupua, bena laulau kahana ta tupua kala henia totona. Kala kererekerere be lasi.
howTo: Raua ta abia hidi.
Kala ta tupua. Kala ta ta be mai ena ladana torea.
Laulau kahana ta tupua unai kala henia totona.
Nega ibounai emu laloa giroa diba ma kala idau henia lou amo.
"Print this page" tupua raua kavakava pepa latanai torea totona, pensil eiava maka amo kala henia totona.
tips: Bema kala momo abia hidi be auka, kala rua mo henia idia amo abia hidi totona.
Au mai kala paapol bona dina mai kala kakarukakaru be idia namo. Inai be moale abia kala dekenai, momokani karana lasi.

conversation-cards.name: Herevahereva kadi
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Hadadai Hebou: Famili Ena Dekenai Kadi
conversation-cards.description: Dekenai kadi, namona hadadai ai hebou famili, lagatai tau, bada hanuaboi tau idia, dementia ena tau idia dekenai. Hadadai ai dogai, ta dala gaukara gaukara ena lalonai.
conversation-cards.short: Laulau kadi mai henanadai manokadia bona kehodia. Henanadai aukadia be lasi.
conversation-cards.intro: Kadi ta ta ese diba laulauna bona herevahereva kehoa henanadaina ia henia, hegeregere "Emu ura bada medu eiava dina negana be dahaka?" Haere maorona sibona lasi bona gau ta laloatao be auka lasi. Hereva ena dala abia hidi eiava iboudiai buloa.
howTo: Hereva ena dala abia hidi, eiava "All cards" dogoatao.
Henanadai gado bada amo duahia bona laulau itaia hebou.
Kamonai, emu haere henia, bona herevahereva do ia lao hehereva.
"Next card" tupua negana oi hegaegae, eiava kadi tamona dekenai noho nega daudau emu ura hegeregerena.
"Print all cards" tupua pepa kadi utua totona.
tips: Oi sibona danu henanadai haerelaia. Ia be herevahereva bamona do ia noho, henanadai gwauraia heheni karana lasi.
Sivarai murinai raka, gau momokanidia lasi. Bema gaudia idia idau, ia namo.
Bema kadi ese lalo-hisihisi gauna ia haginia, unai hemami abia dae bona metairametaira kadi ta dekenai lao.

faq.q: Dahaka dainai "Oi laloatao diba...?" henanadaidia be idia lasi?
faq.a: Laloatao tohoa henanadaidia ese henanadai auka hegeregerena henia diba bona hemarai havaraia diba. Hereva kehodia hegeregere "Lau hadibaia inai gauna dainai..." ese taunimanima iboudiai kahanai henia diba, dahaka idia laloatao be ia hegeregere.

faq.q: Lau ese kadi pepa latanai lau torea diba?
faq.a: Oibe. "Print all cards" ese kadi iboudiai leta badadia amo pepa latanai ia torea, raua tamona lalonai kadi haida, utua totona hegaegae.

faq.q: Ia be davana lasi, bona egu ladana lau torea be namo?
faq.a: Obe, ia be davana lasi, bona akaun, ladana torea eiava download be lasi. Ia be fon, tablet eiava kompiuta ena web browser lalonai e karaiamu.

photo-pairs.name: Laulau hegeregere
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Famili ena Laulau amo Hahegeregere Gadara Karaia
photo-pairs.h1: Laulau Hegeregere: Emu Laulau Korikori Hahegeregere
photo-pairs.description: Emu ruma-bese ena laulau halaoa gadara manoka-manoka ta ai. Emu misini lalonai laulau 2 ela 6 abia hidi; idia be emu browser lalonai e miamu bona internet.
photo-pairs.short: Emu laulau korikori abia hidi bona hahegeregere. Gau ta asie heautoniamu.
photo-pairs.intro: Oi amo telefon, tablet, o computer ena lalonai ta rua ai ono dekenai famili ena dekenai ia, ia ai dekenai pakti lalonai dekenai ena. Dekenai ia edia page ai lalonai ta ai hanamo. Dekenai ia ai bada ai lau, ia ai lalo ai oi karaia ai dekenai ai daika ai kaukau ai hebou. Dekenai ia ai ta famili ena dekenai ai hadadai ai namona.
howTo: “Dekenai ia” ai anina, ai dekenai rua ai ono ai ia.
Dekenai dala dala ai rua ai ena. Ta dala ai anina, bada ena pair ai anina.
If you like, add a few words under each photo. Captions are not saved.
Dekenai dala dala ai ia ai hadadai ai ena.
When you are done, close the page or tap "Clear photos". Nothing is kept.
tips: Moale bona diba momo gaudia edia laulau hekaha abia hidi: sisia eiava pusi, uma, gabu namona ta, headava dinana.
Gabu bona gau edia laulau be aonega hegeregere, vaira laulaudia hegeregerena lasi, bona ladadia gwauraia hekwarahina e hekokorokumu.
Mase taudia edia laulau gwau kau, bema idia ese lalo-hisihisi e mailaiamu, a bema lalo-namo e henimu be hegeregere.

faq.q: Egu laulau be gabu ta ai e heautoniamu?
faq.a: Lasi. Rau ese oi o abia hidi laulaudia na emu browser lalonai e duahimu bona emu skrin ai e hahedinaraimu. Idia na ai eiava tau ta dekenai asie hesiahi henimumu, bona rau o kouamu eiava o hahekahamu lou neganai e ore.

faq.q: Nege e toana klok eiava poin be mia?
faq.a: Lasi. Klok, poin, namba eiava kwadogona be lasi. Nega ibounai oi hegeregere ba hadokoa, bona bogaragosi ai dokona danu be dalanana namona.

faq.q: Nega gabeai totona gadara na baine hedogomu?
faq.a: Browser lalonai be lasi, bona unuhetomana dainai hehuni gauna ta asie hedogomu. Davana lasi Creative Activities app be iPhone bona iPad totona emu misini ai laulau kopidia e naria henimu.

picture-bingo.name: Laulau bingo
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Dekenai Bingo ai Sinabada Hebou Kaukau
picture-bingo.description: Free printable picture bingo for families, senior groups and care homes. Big pictures with words, 9 or 16 squares, and a large on-screen caller.
picture-bingo.short: Torea pepa laulau bingo kadia bona orea totona skrin badana hahedinarai henia gauna.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo korikori namba lasi a laulau ida, bona taunimanima be leta maraḡidia i-duahina asie hekwarahimu. Kadi idau-idau torea henia, bena skrin badana hahedinarai henia gauna amo laulau badadia hahedinaraia TV, laptop eiava tablet ai.
howTo: Kadi ta ta ai kubolu 9 eiava 16 abia hidi bona gadara taudia hida.
"Kadi torea" bapatua. Kadi ta ta na idau-idau.
Skrin badana ai e hedinaraimu gauna kehoa. "Laulau ma ta" bapatua bena laulau ta ta mai ladana ida hahedinaraia.
Gadara taudia ese idia edia kadi ai hegeregere laulauna e hekoupumu moni, baton eiava maka amo.
Irena ta e hahonuamu tauna, eiava kadi idoinai, e hemoalemu. Inai gadara lalonai kwalimu lasi tauna ta lasi: gadara ela bona iboudiai irena ta e abiamu.
tips: Koupa gaudia badadia ḡaukaralaia, hegeregere botolo koudia. Baton maraḡidia i-abi-hisina na auka.
Laulau ladana gwauraia bona ia herevalia: "Boti heau. Daika boti ai e guhi vaduani?"
Mata dika taudia skrin badibadinai haheladaidia, bona durua taudia na hegogo taudia ida haboudia.
Kubolu 9 be orea momo totona hegeregere momokani. Nega hegeregere miniti 20 ela 30 bamona.

faq.q: Naria rumana lalonai laulau bingo ede bana karaiatoma?
faq.a: Gadara tauna ta kadi ta torea henia, hahedinarai gauna na emui skrin badana ai atoa, bona laulau na metairametaira gwauraia, ta ta ladana gwauraia. Gadara ela bona iboudiai irena ta e abiamu, bona ta asine henegeamu.

faq.q: Pepani torea be davana lasi?
faq.a: Obe. Emu ura kadi momo torea henia, nega momo, oi sibona eiava orea totona.

faq.q: Taunimanima na asie duahiduahimu a hegeregere bae gadara?
faq.a: Obe. Kubolu ta ta be laulau badana ta, bona hehuanai ladana e toreamu, revareva e uramu taudia totona.

picnic-planner.name: Pikniki hebou
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Pikniki Hebou: Gau Dekenai Ai Lao Ena
picnic-planner.h1: Picnic Planner: Choose Pictures, Then Match Them
picnic-planner.description: Choose food and things-to-do pictures for a picnic, then play a gentle matching round with them. Nothing is timed. Free to play and print.
picnic-planner.short: Pick food and outing pictures for a picnic, then match them.
picnic-planner.players: Lau dala, o tau rua ai ta lalonai
picnic-planner.intro: Tap pictures of food and things to do to put them in a picnic basket, which holds up to six. A sentence in words says what is in the basket, such as "Our picnic: bread, cheese, apples and a kite." Then tap "Let's play with our picnic" for a gentle matching round made from the chosen pictures. The pictures stay showing, and nothing is timed, scored or saved. "Print our picnic list" prints a checklist of what you chose, with a tick box for each thing to pack.
howTo: Tap a picture of food or something to do. It goes into the basket.
Tap a picture in the basket to take it out again.
Choose at least two things, then tap "Let's play with our picnic".
Tap two pictures that are the same. The pictures stay showing, so there is nothing to remember.
Tap "Print our picnic list" for a paper checklist to take with you.
tips: Ask the people you are with what they would like to bring, and choose the pictures together.
Talk about each picture as it goes in: "Do you remember the kite we flew at the beach?"
On paper, the blank lines are for anything else you want to bring, or for a name.

faq.q: Timer, score o winner ai dogai?
faq.a: Ta. Gaukara ai sisiba o kaukau ai ta, bada tau dala ai ta hanamo. Pair ai hebou lalonai, ta mistake bada point ai ta.

faq.q: Hanaia ai meal plan ai dogai?
faq.a: No. It is a picture plan for an outing, to talk about and to take on paper. It does not say what anyone should eat.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The basket stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or sent, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Paper ai version ai dogai?
faq.a: Yes. "Print our picnic list" prints one page, on A4 or US Letter. It shows the pictures you chose with a tick box for each, and blank lines for anything else.

faq.q: Ai dogai, bada sign up ai hanamo?
faq.a: Io, dogai. Account ta, sign up ta, download ta. Web browser ai phone, tablet o computer lalonai ai hanamo.

scrapbook.name: Scrapbook
scrapbook.seoTitle: Scrapbook: Famili Ena Dekenai Ai Page Dala Dala Ai Hebou
scrapbook.h1: Scrapbook: Amo Ena Dekenai ai Hadadai Ai Hanaia, Bada Page ai Hanamo
scrapbook.description: Choose two to twelve of your own family photos on your device and turn them as a book, with a few words under each. Nothing is uploaded. Free to print.
scrapbook.short: Famili ena dekenai ai page dala dala ai hebou, buka hanaia ai hanamo.
scrapbook.players: Lau dala, o tau rua ai ta lalonai
scrapbook.intro: Choose two to twelve of your own photos from this device. Each photo becomes one page of a book, large enough to see, with an optional few words under it. Turn the pages with the buttons or the arrow keys, and use "Look together" to sit side by side with just the photos and words. Your photos stay on this device. They are not uploaded or saved, and the book is gone when you close the page. "Print the scrapbook" prints one photo and its words on each page, with page numbers.
howTo: Tap "Choose photos" and pick two to twelve photos. Ask before using a photo of someone who cannot say yes.
Turn the pages with "Previous page" and "Next page", or with the Left and Right arrow keys.
Add a few words under a photo if you like. Use "Move earlier" or "Move later" to change the order.
Tap "Look together" to hide the editing controls and look at the book side by side.
Tap "Print the scrapbook" for a paper copy, or "Clear the book" when you are done. Nothing is kept.
tips: Wähle Fotos von schönen, vertrauten Dingen: ein Garten, ein Haustier, ein Lieblingsort. Erzählen Sie beim Umblättern etwas zu jeder Seite.
Lassen Sie die Person zu jeder Seite ein paar Worte sagen, auch nur ein einziges Wort, und schreiben Sie diese genau so auf, wie sie gesagt werden.
Auf Papier können die gedruckten Seiten in einen Ordner gelegt werden, und die Familie kann eigene Bilder und Notizen dazwischen ergänzen.

collage-board.short: Legen Sie abwechselnd Bilder auf einer gemeinsamen Tafel aus.

Jede Person darf aussetzen, und ein Schritt kann zurückgenommen werden. Nichts wird gestoppt, bewertet oder gespeichert. Tippen Sie auf „Anderes Bilderset“ für einen anderen Behälter. Bilder, die schon auf der Tafel liegen, bleiben dort.
Tippen Sie auf „Neu beginnen“, um die Tafel zu leeren, und auf „Zurücklegen“, wenn Sie es sich anders überlegen.
tips: Sagen Sie den Namen jedes Bildes, während Sie es hinlegen, zum Beispiel „Die Teetasse kommt neben das Haus“. Das Gespräch macht daraus eine gemeinsame Beschäftigung.
Lassen Sie beide Personen abwechselnd das Ausschnittbild und den Platz wählen, damit jede ein Mitspracherecht hat.
Auf Papier schneiden Sie die acht Bilder mit etwas Hilfe aus und legen sie dann auf die gedruckten Felder.

garden-planner.short: Wählen Sie Pflanzenbilder aus und gestalten Sie ein Stück Garten mit zwölf Beeten.

faq.a: Hapai. Ena pesi ena ihalaona, ena arrow keys ena brush ring ta hanai, bona Space key ena brush ta dekenai ba ta ania. Ena screen ena "Brush down" bona "Brush up" ta hanai.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: No. Watercolor on paper is the same idea, a wet brush and one color at a time, so it is a different activity to try at the table.

faq.q: What colors are they?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green bona purple, ena hanaina kala haida ta ena picture games ta hanai. Kala tahi ta ena written name ena, bona name ena choice ena tabua ai.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.
